_about: Monochrome Cinema variant from Top-100 rank 29 (ciggmedia, 'this isn't a skill problem, it's an environment problem', 41 s). The warm, golden-hour member of the family: speaker plate lit by orange window light, kept in colour and warm; captions are small white bold sans phrases sitting LOW (~65-75% down, under the chest), and the one money/action word per line goes big bold sans in YELLOW ('$500', 'LINK'). Cutaways are the creator's own warm workspace b-roll (hands on keyboard, desk, monitor) in colour, not B&W stock; no black word cards. Measured: picture change 1.37 s (19 punch-ins + 10 cuts in 41 s), caption every 0.49 s, captions 65% down, face 46% down / 26% of frame, luma 89, sat 104 (brightest, most saturated variant), -17.6 LUFS, ~34 sound hits/min.

director.style: Monochrome Cinema (golden desk): a warm creator-economy talking head. Captions low and quiet; one yellow money/action word per line. B-roll of the work itself, in warm colour.
director.captions: captions.heroes: only numbers, money and action words ('$500', 'skill', 'link', 'improved'); most phrases stay small (heroFallback none). captions.serif: none. Lowercase except numbers and the CTA word.
director.wordcards: No black word cards in this variant.
director.cutaways: 3-5 image scenes per 30 s, captions: true, 1.0-2.0 s, grade sepia(0.18) saturate(0.95) contrast(1.1) brightness(0.84): desk, keyboard, hands typing, monitor glow, window light. If the user uploads screen/b-roll footage, use it here first. Public domain / CC0 via stock_fetch.py otherwise.
director.rhythm: Picture change every ~2-3 s; cut to b-roll on the 'work' sentences, return to the speaker on the claim.
